evidence.title: AI4AI-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Algorithmic Design for Recursive Self-Improvement

summary: Researchers have released AI4AI‑Bench, a new suite of tasks that evaluates large language model agents on algorithmic design problems aimed at recursive self‑improvement. The benchmark provides standardized metrics to compare how effectively LLMs can generate, analyze, and iteratively refine code that enhances their own capabilities.
title: AI4AI‑Bench Introduces Benchmark for Testing LLM Agents on Recursive Self‑Improvement Algorithms
